title: Video detail route lacks included regression coverage
reasoning: The feature exposes the video detail endpoint at videos/<int:pk>/, but no linked tests were provided for URL resolution, accepted pk shape, or dispatch to VideoDetailView. This leaves the route vulnerable to accidental rename/removal or converter changes without a targeted failure.
recommendation: Add a focused URL test that reverses video-detail with a numeric pk, asserts it resolves to VideoDetailView, and optionally verifies a representative GET through the API routing layer if fixtures are available.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature metadata lists no tests, and the included excerpts contain only the route declaration.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Django URLConf test for reverse('video-detail', kwargs={'pk': 1}) and resolve('/api/learning-resources/videos/1/') targeting VideoDetailView.
minimumFixScope: Test-only change covering the video detail route contract.
